label: Mouse button
description: Press a mouse button down, or let it up, where the mouse is on the computer's screen. Pressed and released as separate steps around MoveMouse, it makes a drag step by step. `args` is `{ action, button }`: `action` down or up, `button` left (the default), right, middle, back or forward.

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: The `computer` output of the Computer node to act on.

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: The press, in the shape the node's description gives. RouteComputerCall's `mouseButton` port hands it over from a model's tool call; written by hand, it is a record literal.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: What happened, in a sentence a model can read back as the tool's result.

metadataPorts.name: tools
metadataPorts.description: The tools a model calls this node through, in Anthropic's names and in OpenAI's: gather them up to the LLM node's `tools` through metadata ports.

anthropic.description: Press the left button down where the mouse is and keep it down: with mouse_move and left_mouse_up, a drag made step by step.
anthropic.name: left_mouse_down

anthropic.description: Let the left button up where the mouse is.
anthropic.name: left_mouse_up
